acceptanceCriteria: The owner decides whether build numbers restart from the public lineage or carry an offset, and the producer plus PUB-V0-021 record the rule.
body: Filed on 2026-09-23 from the independent reviews and worker reports of the V1 wave-2 pull requests (#82-#85). PR #84 (V1-0017): origin/main stamps build 12 while the published 0.7.0 is build 46 because decision 0331 restarted the first-parent count.
title: release: build numbers are no longer monotonic after the public-history reset (PUB-V0-021)
